constraints:
FK application_answers_application_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK application_answers_question_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (question_id) REFERENCES job_questions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK application_answers_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK application_status_notifications_application_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK application_status_notifications_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

CHECK applications_status_check: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['applied'::character varying, 'under_review'::character varying, 'interview'::character varying, 'offer'::character varying, 'hired'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying])::text[])))
FK applications_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK applications_worker_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK applications_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE applications_job_id_worker_id_key: UNIQUE (job_id, worker_id)
UNIQUE applications_unique_worker_job: UNIQUE (worker_id, job_id)

FK certification_details_worker_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK certification_details_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK chat_messages_conversation_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK chat_messages_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
PK contact_messages_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK conversations_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
PK conversations_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE conversations_employer_id_worker_id_job_id_key: UNIQUE (employer_id, worker_id, job_id)

FK education_worker_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK education_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK employer_profiles_user_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK employer_profiles_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK interviews_application_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (application_id) REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK interviews_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK job_questions_job_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (job_id) REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK job_questions_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

CHECK jobs_job_type_check: CHECK (((job_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['full-time'::character varying, 'part-time'::character varying, 'contract'::character varying, 'per-diem'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK jobs_salary_type_check: CHECK (((salary_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['hourly'::character varying, 'annual'::character varying])::text[])))
FK jobs_employer_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (employer_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK jobs_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK licenses_worker_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK licenses_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK notifications_user_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK notifications_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

PK push_subscriptions_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE push_subscriptions_endpoint_key: UNIQUE (endpoint)

CHECK reviews_rating_check: CHECK (((rating >= 1) AND (rating <= 5)))
FK reviews_reviewee_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (reviewee_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FK reviews_reviewer_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK reviews_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK subscriptions_user_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK subscriptions_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

CHECK users_role_check: CHECK (((role)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['worker'::character varying, 'employer'::character varying, 'admin'::character varying])::text[])))
PK users_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE users_email_key: UNIQUE (email)
PK webhook_events_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK work_experience_worker_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK work_experience_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK worker_languages_worker_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK worker_languages_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)

FK worker_profiles_user_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
PK worker_profiles_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
UNIQUE worker_profiles_user_id_unique: UNIQUE (user_id)
